title: Move Memory from ChatGPT to Claude
description: This video explains how to migrate your chat history and memory settings from ChatGPT to Claude. I'll show you how to export your ChatGPT data, including preferences and learned information, and then import it into Claude's memory system. This process allows Claude AI to retain context about your work and preferences, making subsequent interactions feel more personalized, a great AI hack for anyone using these AI tools.
